title: ReviewAnswerRecorded.v1
description: Emitted when a user records or updates a single answer within a review. Also emitted when an answer is cleared (answer: null).

questionId.description: Unique identifier of the question being answered.
questionId.markdownDescription: Unique identifier of the question being answered.

answer.description: The answer value, or null when the answer is cleared.
answer.markdownDescription: The answer value, or null when the answer is cleared.

naReason.description: Free-text reason when the question is marked Not Applicable.
naReason.markdownDescription: Free-text reason when the question is marked Not Applicable.

itemNaReasons.description: Serialised per-item N/A reasons for multi-item questions, or null.
itemNaReasons.markdownDescription: Serialised per-item N/A reasons for multi-item questions, or null.

pillarSlug.description: URL-safe slug of the pillar this question belongs to.
pillarSlug.markdownDescription: URL-safe slug of the pillar this question belongs to.

templateId.description: ID of the template containing this question.
templateId.markdownDescription: ID of the template containing this question.
